public_rationale: Zitron said Google claimed 25% of its code was AI-written and that he expected Microsoft was not far behind. Google's Q3 2024 remarks confirm the baseline. On April 29, 2025, about six months after the post, Satya Nadella said 'maybe 20%, 30%' of the code in Microsoft's repos is written by software. That is in the same range as Google's figure, so Microsoft was not far behind by its own account. Caveats: Nadella hedged, his figure measures code in repos rather than new code, and no Microsoft figure exists for November 2024 itself. Reading the claim strictly as Microsoft's state on the post date would leave it unresolved.
limitations: The result depends on reading 'anticipate... isn't far behind' as a near-term expectation, not strictly a statement about November 2024.
The two companies use different measures and both are self-reported, unverified estimates.

criteria.contradiction_condition: A Microsoft executive or disclosure in that window puts the share well below Google's figure, for example under about 10%.
